_note: FICTIONAL AND ILLUSTRATIVE. This is a demonstration work sample, not an appraisal and not a real hotel or transaction. Every figure below is a stated assumption in a plausible range for an upscale Zurich city hotel, unless a source is named in the accompanying review. Do not quote any number here as market data.

_assumption_labels.occupancy_year1: assumption. Positioned below the cited Zurich city average of 74.8% (JLL, H1 2025) to represent an underperforming asset.
_assumption_labels.adr_year1: assumption. Set below the upscale Zurich comparable set to represent a rate-lagging asset.
_assumption_labels.outlet_revenue_and_margin: assumption. F&B margin set at the low end to represent under-invested, poorly merchandised space.
_assumption_labels.undistributed_costs: assumption. Elevated as a share of revenue to represent an over-staffed, under-managed cost base.
_assumption_labels.cap_and_discount_rates: assumption. Going-in cap above exit cap and discount rate above exit cap to reflect value-add risk.
_assumption_labels.forecast_paths: assumption. Represents a five year repositioning case.

name: Fictional 140-room upscale hotel, Zurich city (demonstration case)
